data.one_liner: A wrapper for the Brazilian PIX API compatible with most PSPs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart wrapper around the PIX API to generate static QR codes, manage immediate or due-date charges, handle batch charges, configure webhooks, and process refunds.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app that integrates with Brazilian PIX payment systems.
You need to handle PIX charges, immediate collections, and webhook configurations.
avoid_when: You need built-in UI components for rendering the QR code directly (requires a separate package like qr_flutter).
You are working with non-Brazilian payment gateways.
strengths: Supports multiple types of PIX charges including immediate, due-date, and batch collections.
Compatible with most Payment Service Providers (PSPs) following the official PIX API standard.
weaknesses: Does not render QR codes natively, requiring an external package like qr_flutter.
Documentation relies heavily on external PSP and official PIX docs.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. Note that you may need an additional package like qr_flutter to display the generated QR code graphics.
